_doc: Tours, hands-on (gameplay plan: sell tickets at the pier, guide the tour, tour rating). The tours themselves (id, name, hour, price, cost, seats) stay in customization.json operations.tours; here are the guided stops and the pier places. Buyers come to the booth in the hours before a departure; the player sells (the guide sells by himself). In the departure hour the player can guide: three stops, each with a good, an acceptable and a bad choice (shown shuffled); rating = 2 + 1 per good + 0.5 per acceptable, tip = 10% of the tickets per good choice. Not guided by the end of that hour: the guide runs it (rating 3.5) or, without a guide, it is cancelled and refunded. World cm: booth = E target [x, y, z, yaw], queue = first buyer spot and the step between buyers, board = where boarding passengers walk.
